meta.title: Uttar Pradesh chicken price influencing events calendar
meta.description: A sourced calendar of religious, social, seasonal and weather events that plausibly move wholesale chicken prices in Uttar Pradesh. Expected price impact is a research hypothesis, not a measured effect. This file is the source of truth; scripts/build_event_calendar.mjs flattens it into app/data/up_chicken_events.json.
meta.coverage_start_rule: Derived at build and load time from the first quoted day in app/data/chicken_rates.json. Never hardcoded.
calendar_conventions: Hindu festival and month dates are taken from Drik Panchang, computed with Drik Ganita for New Delhi, the nearest large panchang reference for Uttar Pradesh. UP follows the purnimanta month convention; that is stated on each month-long observance.

Islamic dates come from a published India holiday calendar. In India the observed date depends on local moon sighting, so 2027 Islamic dates are marked tentative and 2026 dates carry an estimated/confirmed label that reflects what was observed.
Seasonal entries are climatological norms from IMD season definitions, not forecasts. They are marked estimated and must not be read as predictions for a specific year.
meta.impact_disclaimer: expected_price_impact and impact_mechanism are hypotheses about direction, built from how the event affects demand, supply and logistics. They are not estimates of magnitude and are not measured against the price series.

definitions.impact_mechanism: Five days of household hosting, sweets, gifts and visiting relatives concentrate catering and banquet orders, while transporters and shop staff take leave and arrivals thin out at the same time.

sources.title: Kanwar Yatra
sources.supports: Annual Shiva pilgrimage from the start of Shravana; notes traffic diversion on the Delhi-Haridwar highway and Uttar Pradesh participation.

definitions.notes: Modelled with the purnimanta month, which UP follows: Shravana runs from the day after Ashadha Purnima to Shravana Purnima. Under the amanta convention used in parts of western and southern India the same days fall in a differently named month, which is why published 'Sawan dates' can differ by about a fortnight. Purnimanta windows: 10 Jul - 9 Aug 2025 (Ashadha Purnima 10 Jul, Shravana Purnima 9 Aug); 30 Jul - 28 Aug 2026 (Adhika Jyeshtha pushes Shravana late); 19 Jul - 17 Aug 2027. Some almanacs start Sawan on 11 Jul 2025; the one-day difference is a month-start convention, not a date error.

definitions.name: Pre-monsoon summer heat season
definitions.calendar_system: Climatological (IMD season definitions)
definitions.impact_mechanism: Sustained heat above roughly 40 C raises bird mortality and cuts weight gain in open sheds, tightening supply, while households shift to lighter meals and retail footfall drops in the afternoon. The net price direction varies by year.
definitions.description: The recurring pre-monsoon heat of the Gangetic plain, when daytime temperatures routinely pass 40 C and open poultry sheds come under stress.

sources.title: Climate of Uttar Pradesh
sources.supports: IMD-defined seasons for Uttar Pradesh: summer March-May, monsoon June-October, winter November-February with foggy conditions.

definitions.notes: A recurring seasonal norm, not a forecast and not a specific heatwave. The window 15 Apr - 30 Jun is a research convention derived from the IMD summer season (March-May), narrowed to the hottest stretch, and is marked estimated for every year. Recorded separately from any confirmed heatwave.

definitions.name: 2025 heat wave (reported, subcontinent-wide)
definitions.calendar_system: Confirmed weather event (reported national/subcontinental episode)
definitions.location_scope: Uttar Pradesh (statewide exposure; district peaks not verified)
definitions.impact_mechanism: An early and prolonged heat episode can cut poultry weights and marketable arrivals while also suppressing retail demand. Both channels are plausible; neither is measured here.
definitions.description: A reported subcontinent-wide heat episode that began in early April 2025 and ran into July 2025, covering the first months of the price series.

sources.title: 2025 India-Pakistan heat wave
sources.supports: Reported onset in early April 2025 and end in July 2025 of the 2025 heat wave across the subcontinent.

definitions.notes: Included to separate a confirmed anomaly from the recurring seasonal norm. The episode is documented at subcontinental level; UP-specific IMD bulletins and district peak dates were not retrieved, so the window is the reported national span rather than a UP declaration. Reported onset early April 2025 and end July 2025. Do not read this as an IMD heatwave declaration for any particular UP district.

definitions.name: Southwest monsoon season
definitions.calendar_system: Climatological (IMD season definitions)
definitions.impact_mechanism: Heavy rain slows road transport and can delay arrivals into mandis, which tightens supply, while cooler days and disrupted retail hours pull demand down. Flooded approach roads are the main disruption risk.
definitions.description: The southwest monsoon over the Gangetic plain, which supplies about 85 per cent of the state's annual rainfall between June and October.

sources.title: Climate of Uttar Pradesh
sources.supports: IMD-defined seasons for Uttar Pradesh: summer March-May, monsoon June-October, winter November-February with foggy conditions.

definitions.notes: A recurring seasonal norm. IMD places the UP monsoon in June-October; the window here is the core June-September period and is an analyst convention, marked estimated for every year.

definitions.name: Winter fog and cold-wave transport disruption
definitions.calendar_system: Climatological (IMD season definitions)
definitions.location_scope: Uttar Pradesh, statewide (NH-19 Delhi-Kanpur-Varanasi corridor strongest)
definitions.impact_mechanism: Dense winter fog delays trucks and can hold up live-bird movement between districts, tightening arrivals, while cold weather also reduces outdoor dining and wedding-season crowding. The two effects can offset.
definitions.description: The dense winter fog of the Gangetic plain, most frequent from the second half of December through January, when visibility on the Delhi-Kanpur-Varanasi corridor collapses.

sources.title: Climate of Uttar Pradesh
sources.supports: IMD-defined seasons for Uttar Pradesh: summer March-May, monsoon June-October, winter November-February with foggy conditions.

definitions.notes: A recurring seasonal norm. The 15 Dec - 31 Jan window is an analyst convention, marked estimated for every year. The 2027 occurrence is cut at the coverage end.

definitions.name: Wedding season (Lagan) muhurat cluster
definitions.calendar_system: Hindu lunisolar muhurat (Drik Panchang, New Delhi)
definitions.impact_mechanism: Wedding catering is one of the largest chicken channels in UP. Muhurats cluster into a few short blocks each year, and banquet demand concentrates on those dates rather than spreading evenly across the season.
definitions.description: The Lagan wedding season, when Hindu marriage muhurats cluster into a few short blocks rather than spreading across the year. Each occurrence is one cluster; the exact muhurat dates are listed in its notes.
